critical_findings.finding: Buggy demonstration presented as a working FizzBuzz procedure. Combined divisibility branch is after individual branches; 15 returns fizz rather than fizzbuzz. Source explicitly calls the first version wrong and then repairs it.

mortgage equals principal multiplied by monthly interest rate is an incomplete expression presented as the formula. Transcript explicitly continues with another expression and an exponent n. Missing visually referenced components must be marked unavailable, not treated as a complete formula.

Literal double result = (double)10 / 3; plus result/comment is reconstructed from spoken explanation, not a verbatim source code snippet. This violates the project source-only literal-code contract, independently of whether the snippet computes a plausible value.
